scientific_question: For the standard LARE interface closure, how much instantaneous flux error arises from nonlinear constitutive averaging, from localizing interface conductivity, and from reconstructing the hydraulic gradient from layer means?

reference.route: fine 16 x 10 cm DYN0A fixed-flux Reference Richards
reference.cases: only fine-Reference cases already QUALIFIED inside the strict-unsaturated common domain

constitutive.qualified_branch: h < -0.01 cm, so standard unsaturated MvG is used; no near-saturation smoothing is reconstructed

fine_reference_interface_flux.conductivity_mean: arithmetic mean of the two adjacent fine-cell conductivities because DYN0A Reference fixes swkmean=1
fine_reference_interface_flux.sign: positive downward, matching the integrated-LARE convention
fine_reference_interface_flux.provenance: headcalc internal residual uses kmean*head_gradient with head_gradient=(h_upper-h_lower)/distance+1

decomposition.q_standard: Published/source-anchored LARE closure evaluated on exact projected layer storage: psi_i=psi(theta_bar_i), K_i=K(theta_bar_i), thickness-weighted K interface, layer-center gradient.
decomposition.q_exact_layer_means: Same LARE interface interpolation and layer-center gradient, but replace psi(theta_bar) and K(theta_bar) by exact volume means of fine-reference psi and K within each layer.
decomposition.q_local_K_mean_gradient: Use exact fine-reference interface K_face while retaining the gradient reconstructed from exact layer-mean psi.
decomposition.q_reference: Fine-reference local Darcy flux at the same interface.
signed_identity: E_total = E_constitutive + E_K_localization + E_gradient to floating-point tolerance
decomposition.note: Components are signed diagnostic increments. Absolute magnitudes are not interpreted as additive percentages because cancellation is possible.

metrics: per interface/case maximum absolute total flux error
per interface/case RMS total flux error
per interface/case RMS magnitude of each signed component
time and observation step of maximum total error
component values at maximum total error
D3 versus D4 closure error at shared interfaces 140 and 150 cm

adjudication.CONSTITUTIVE_AVERAGING_DOMINANT: Across high-error cases, E_constitutive has the largest RMS component magnitude at the interface(s) controlling the propagated error.
adjudication.INTERFACE_LOCALIZATION_DOMINANT: E_K_localization has the largest RMS component magnitude.
adjudication.GRADIENT_RECONSTRUCTION_DOMINANT: E_gradient has the largest RMS component magnitude.
adjudication.MIXED_CLOSURE_ERROR: No single component is largest across the relevant high-error cases/interfaces, or strong signed cancellation makes a single-mechanism label misleading.
adjudication.next_rule: Do not modify the closure until this diagnostic is closed. Do not add D5/D6 merely because D4 improved D3.
